ylva_halsning_01.text: The runes sleep, child. But they dream.

ylva_halsning_02.text: You woke them. I felt it in my bones.

ylva_halsning_03.text: The Fourth Stone, child. It all comes back to that.

ylva_rykte_01.text: The runes in the forest sleep. But they dream.

ylva_rykte_02.text: Someone has woken the runes. The Red Portal stands open at the heart of the forest.

ylva_rykte_03.text: Little Mira has stopped waiting by the road. She helps Sigrun now.

ylva_rykte_04.text: The Whisperer sits by Ylva's fire now. He whispers no more.

ylva_rykte_05.text: Bror buried his son in the bear's pelt. There is a new cross by the camp.

ylva_rykte_06.text: Ylva says the Runecarver snuffed out the Fourth Stone himself. She talks of lighting it again.

ylva_rykte_07.text: Ylva tells of the Runecarver, a hero who died in battle.

ylva_rykte_08.text: They say there was a fourth runestone. It lies on the Rift's Floor.

ylva_quest_01.text: No one remembers who carved the stones. But the stones remember. Look at them by moonlight, child.

ylva_quest_02.text: Look at the stones by moonlight, child.

ylva_quest_03.text: He snuffed it out himself? Then he's the one waiting down there. Then someone must light it again.

ylva_quest_04.text: A hero, then. I knew it. The runes were made by someone brave.

ylva_bark_03.text: The ash, child. Don't breathe the ash.

ylva_bark_05.text: He put it out himself. Himself.

tor_halsning_01.text: Got gold? Then I've got goods.

tor_rykte_01.text: There are more wolves every night.

tor_rykte_02.text: The Greybear of Wolfstead is dead. They say Hedda wept for joy.

tor_rykte_03.text: Ulvhild's pelt hangs in Hedda's hunting lodge. She sleeps through the night now.

sigrun_halsning_01.text: Sit down. Let me look at you.

sigrun_halsning_02.text: Mira has gentle hands. She does me good.

sigrun_rykte_01.text: The Blight is spreading. A bite that turns green is a death sentence.

sigrun_rykte_02.text: Little Mira has stopped waiting by the road. She helps Sigrun now.

sigrun_rykte_03.text: Bror buried his son in the bear's pelt. There is a new cross by the camp.

bror_halsning_01.text: Keep to the path. The forest is hungry.

bror_halsning_02.text: You chose the huntress. Be on your way.

bror_halsning_03.text: He rests now. Thanks to you.

bror_rykte_01.text: There are more wolves every night.

bror_rykte_02.text: Skeletons have been seen by the cairns to the north.

bror_rykte_03.text: The Whisperer sits by Ylva's fire now. He whispers no more.

bror_rykte_04.text: Bror buried his son in the bear's pelt. There is a new cross by the camp.

bror_quest_01.text: My boy lies somewhere in her den. I want to bury him in the thing that took him.

bror_quest_02.text: Ulvhild still lives. I can feel it.

bror_quest_03.text: Thank you. He can rest now. Take the axe. I can't bear to look at it.

bror_bark_06.text: A good night for the watch.

mira_halsning_03.text: He isn't here. You said he was here.

mira_rykte_01.text: A child fled toward Wolfstead in new sandals. He never got there.

mira_rykte_02.text: Little Mira says someone saw her brother in Wolfstead. She wants to go there.

mira_quest_01.text: Have you seen my brother? He ran toward Wolfstead. He had new sandals. Will you look for him?

mira_quest_02.text: Did you find him? His sandals were new.

mira_quest_03.text: They're his. I knew it. Take the doll. He'd want someone to have it.

mira_quest_04.text: He's alive? I knew it! I'll go there one day.

mira_bark_06.text: Has anyone seen a boy in new sandals?

mira_avsked_01.text: Tell me if you see him.

viskaren_halsning_01.text: Do you hear them? No. You never hear.

viskaren_halsning_02.text: It's quiet now. I'd forgotten what quiet sounds like.

viskaren_halsning_03.text: The skull talks to you now. Not to me.

viskaren_rykte_01.text: A hermit whispers to bones by a cairn in the northwest.

viskaren_rykte_02.text: The Whisperer laughs at night. He says the skull has chosen.

viskaren_quest_01.text: My brother whispers. Every night. He's still in the house in Wolfstead. Bring him to me.

viskaren_quest_02.text: He's still whispering. Can't you hear?

viskaren_quest_03.text: Silence. At last, silence. Thank you. Take the fingers. They no longer point at you.

viskaren_quest_04.text: He chose you. Do you hear him now? No. But you will.

viskaren_bark_05.text: Warm yourself. The fire doesn't whisper.

viskaren_bark_06.text: He chose you. He chose you.

hedda_halsning_01.text: Fur, bone, arrows. That's all Wolfstead has.

hedda_halsning_02.text: Wolfstead has nothing left for me.

hedda_rykte_01.text: The Greybear of Wolfstead is dead. They say Hedda wept for joy.

hedda_rykte_02.text: A grey wolf with a chain around its neck leads the packs.

hedda_rykte_03.text: Little Mira says someone saw her brother in Wolfstead. She wants to go there.

hedda_rykte_04.text: Ulvhild's pelt hangs in Hedda's hunting lodge. She sleeps through the night now.

hedda_quest_01.text: Ulvhild ate my husband. I want her pelt on my wall.

hedda_quest_02.text: Ulvhild still lives. I can feel it.

hedda_quest_03.text: There she hangs. Now I can sleep.

hedda_bark_02.text: The grey wolves are moving south.

ebbe_halsning_01.text: No one should come here. Yet here you are.

ebbe_halsning_02.text: The children want the Chronicle again.

ebbe_halsning_03.text: You again. The dead remember what you did.

ebbe_rykte_01.text: Chieftain Valdemar wears a crown that binds the whole village.

ebbe_rykte_02.text: The Bone King has fallen. The dead of the Old Village lie still.

ebbe_rykte_03.text: The Gravewardens' gear still lies where they fell.

ebbe_rykte_04.text: Ebbe reads the Gravewardens' Chronicle to the children by the portal.

ebbe_rykte_05.text: Valdemar rests in the chieftain's grave with his signet. The graveyard is still.

ebbe_rykte_06.text: Sara has built an altar from Valdemar's bones. Ebbe refuses to enter the chapel.

ebbe_quest_01.text: My brothers fell down there. I heard them singing. Then nothing. Find out how they died.

ebbe_quest_02.text: The crypt waits. My brothers wait.

ebbe_quest_03.text: They held. All of them. To the last man. Take the lid. It was our captain's.

ebbe_quest_04.text: My grandfather? He held the door? Then I will hold the gate.

ebbe_quest_05.text: The crown rules him, not his own will. Bring him down, and let us bury a chieftain, not a monster.

ebbe_quest_06.text: Valdemar is waiting for his grave.

ebbe_quest_07.text: Rest, Valdemar. The village is yours again.

ebbe_quest_08.text: Wear it well. It weighed on him too.

ebbe_quest_09.text: You gave him to the bonereader? Then let him talk to her.

ebbe_bark_02.text: The lantern burns for the dead.

ebbe_bark_05.text: And Ebbe's brothers held, to the last man.

marta_halsning_01.text: New faces! New faces at last!

marta_halsning_02.text: The hero in the flesh! Come, come, have a look!

marta_rykte_01.text: People are moving back to the Old Village. It smells of bread again.

marta_rykte_02.text: The bells of Mistshore toll beneath the water.

marta_rykte_03.text: Ebbe reads the Gravewardens' Chronicle to the children by the portal.

marta_rykte_04.text: The Bone King has fallen. The dead of the Old Village lie still.

marta_rykte_05.text: Valdemar rests in the chieftain's grave with his signet. The graveyard is still.

gunnar_halsning_01.text: I don't forge anymore. But I sell.

gunnar_halsning_02.text: Good steel you're wearing. Not mine, but good.

gunnar_rykte_01.text: The smith who forged the Runeforged Blade died that same night.

gunnar_rykte_02.text: Ashenhold still burns, thirty years on.

gunnar_bark_03.text: Buying weapons. Anything you pry off the dead.

ingrid_halsning_01.text: This village is under my protection.

ingrid_halsning_02.text: The Gravewardens live on in us now.

ingrid_halsning_03.text: Ebbe is dead. Someone must guard the gate.

ingrid_rykte_01.text: People are moving back to the Old Village. It smells of bread again.

ingrid_rykte_02.text: The village has guards now. Farmers with spears, but they hold.

ingrid_rykte_03.text: Ingrid wears her grandfather's Gravewarden crest. The guards drill every dawn now.

ingrid_rykte_04.text: {hjalte} wears the chieftain's signet. Some say the village has a new chieftain.

ingrid_bark_06.text: The lantern will burn again. One day.

olle_halsning_02.text: There you are! Everyone's talking about you.

olle_rykte_01.text: The bells of Mistshore toll beneath the water.

olle_rykte_02.text: Someone has seen light in Ashenhold again. Not fire. Something else.

olle_rykte_03.text: {hjalte} has slain {antal_bossar} of the lords of darkness. People are starting to hope.

olle_rykte_04.text: The Greybear of Wolfstead is dead. They say Hedda wept for joy.

olle_rykte_05.text: Ulvhild's pelt hangs in Hedda's hunting lodge. She sleeps through the night now.

olle_rykte_06.text: Ylva says the Runecarver snuffed out the Fourth Stone himself. She talks of lighting it again.

olle_rykte_07.text: Ingrid wears her grandfather's Gravewarden crest. The guards drill every dawn now.

olle_rykte_08.text: The Bone King has fallen. The dead of the Old Village lie still.

olle_rykte_09.text: Valdemar rests in the chieftain's grave with his signet. The graveyard is still.

olle_rykte_10.text: {hjalte} wears the chieftain's signet. Some say the village has a new chieftain.

olle_rykte_11.text: Sara has built an altar from Valdemar's bones. Ebbe refuses to enter the chapel.

olle_bark_02.text: Half of it's lies, the other half's worse!

sara_halsning_02.text: Valdemar speaks to me now. He is angry.

sara_rykte_01.text: A hermit whispers to bones by a cairn in the northwest.

sara_rykte_02.text: Folk say {hjalte} carries {foremal}. No one has seen the like in thirty years.

sara_rykte_03.text: The Whisperer laughs at night. He says the skull has chosen.

sara_rykte_04.text: Sara has built an altar from Valdemar's bones. Ebbe refuses to enter the chapel.

sara_bark_01.text: The bones speak clearer at night.

sara_quest_01.text: Valdemar's bones are speaking. Give them to me, and I will listen.

sara_quest_02.text: The bones are waiting. The signet too.

sara_quest_03.text: He is mine now. He is very angry. Thank you.
